title: Add New User
description: Native single-site Add New User form. POSTs to /wp/v2/users via core-data and navigates to the new user's edit screen.

documentation.purpose: Native single-site "Add New User" screen. Replaces the legacy `iframe:user-new.php` mount on the `core:users-new` screen. Renders a `DataForm` create flow (username, email, first/last name, website, password, role, send-notification toggle) and POSTs to `/wp/v2/users` via `saveEntityRecord('root','user', payload)`, navigating to the new user's edit screen on success. Role options come from the resolved `root/user` dataView `roles` elements (admin.json-controlled, translated) with the standard WordPress roles as a fallback. Rebuilds the single-site half of wp-admin's `user-new.php` createuser form.

reads.purpose: Resolved `root/user` dataView doc — read via `useDataView({ kind, name })` to source the role select options (translated labels) from the `roles` field `elements`. Falls back to the standard WordPress roles when the spec ships no elements.

writes.purpose: Create a new user with `saveEntityRecord('root','user', { username, email, first_name, last_name, url, password, roles:[role] })`. The blocking save returns the new record so the app can navigate to its edit screen.

navigates: #/users/{id}/edit (the new user's edit screen on success)

states.renders: DataForm with username / email / first / last / website / password / role / send-notification, Add New User + Cancel buttons. Add is disabled until required fields are valid.
Add New User button shows loading + disabled state; Cancel disabled.

interactions.trigger: Type in any field / choose role / toggle notification
interactions.effect: Local create draft `data` updates via DataForm `onChange`.

`saveEntityRecord('root','user', payload)` (blocking); strips the informational `send_user_notification` flag from the payload; on success: success snackbar + navigate to the new user's edit screen. On failure (resolved `undefined` OR thrown): error notice via `getLastEntitySaveError`, form stays.

a11y.focus-management: DataForm fields are in document order; native focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: `saveEntityRecord` RESOLVES `undefined` on a REST failure (it does not throw). A falsy record means the create failed — read `getLastEntitySaveError('root','user')` and surface it; do not show a false success snackbar.

`send_user_notification` is NOT in the REST create schema (`POST /wp/v2/users`). The checkbox is rendered read-only + off (with helper text) and stripped from the payload — ignored server-side, so the standard welcome email is not sent. Because of that, the generated password is the user's only credential, so it is generated with a CSPRNG (`window.crypto.getRandomValues`). Closing the email gap needs an upstream `send_user_notification` arg (see docs/parity/users.md blocker #5).
REST expects `roles` as an array; the single role select value is wrapped (`roles: [ value ]`) before the POST.
On success the app navigates to `#/users/{id}/edit`, which the wp-admin-default shell binds to `core:profile` with `config.userId` — there is no dedicated Edit User app yet (parity gap).

design-system-leakage.purpose: Heading, helper text, submit / cancel buttons.
